Subject: RFP bake-off: request for extended eval & credits

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood’s latency profile. We’re running a formal RFP bake-off next month against two managed LLM providers and an internal baseline. Procurement and engineering want a realistic evaluation window so they can load representative workloads.

High-level ask:
- 8-week evaluation window (start date flexible in March)
- 200k tokens of free eval credits (to cover multiple model variants and A/B runs)
- Access to logs/metrics for our engineers (read-only) during the trial

We’ve attached the RFP scope and baseline workload (helio_rfp_requirements.pdf). Procurement is copied — happy to share the vendor comparison criteria if that helps.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the credits and a private evaluation instance (VPC peering) for sensitive PHI test vectors? Also please outline any paperwork needed from our side (NDA/Master Agreement).

Best,
Avery Cole

Thanks for forwarding. High-level guidance: we can support the bake-off but want to be cautious on the full ask. Proposal from leadership:

- Offer an initial package of 120k tokens + 4-week eval window (hosted) immediately.
- Provide a conditional top-up of 80k tokens (to reach 200k) contingent on HelioHealth completing a short benchmark report that includes competitor configurations and a signed non-binding MA stating they won’t redistribute our model artifacts.
- For PHI-sensitive vectors, we can provide Private (VPC) evaluation with a short scoping call with Security to confirm network controls (SOC2 evidence will be required).

Please attach an eval plan and a simple MA acknowledgement. I’ve drafted the checklist and attached a template eval plan and a non-binding MA we can use.

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
